WITH grp AS (

  UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE x.campaign_id=15),
s AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,
    sum(f.net_amount) a_all,
    sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) a_nostaff,
    sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND st.store_id<>999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) a_clean,
    sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) a_train
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key

  SELECT m.member_id, sum(rl.refund_net) refunds, sum(CASE WHEN sl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30' THEN rl.refund_net ELSE 0 END) refunds_of_window_sales
  FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl USING(sales_line_id)
  WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g, count(*) n, sum(a_all)/count(*) avg_all, sum(a_nostaff)/count(*) avg_nostaff, sum(a_clean)/count(*) avg_clean, sum(a_train) train, sum(a_clean - coalesce(refunds,0))/count(*) avg_clean_net_ret, sum(a_clean - coalesce(refunds_of_window_sales,0))/count(*) avg_clean_net_ret_same, sum(refunds) refunds, sum(refunds_of_window_sales) rws

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.holdout_size, c.mailing_list_size, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) hrows, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) exp
FROM dim_campaign c WHERE end_date >= '2025-09-01' ORDER BY start_date

WITH grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'holdout' AS grp FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE x.campaign_id = 15),
sales AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1),
refunds AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key)
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY 1),
per_group AS (
  SELECT g.grp, count(*) AS members, sum(coalesce(s.sales_net,0) - coalesce(r.refund_net,0)) / count(*) AS avg_spend
  FROM grp g LEFT JOIN sales s USING (member_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (member_id) GROUP BY g.grp)
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name,
  round(max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN avg_spend END),2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur,
  round(max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN avg_spend END),2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur,
  round(max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN avg_spend END) - max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN avg_spend END),2) AS uplift_eur,
  max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN avg_spend END) - max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN avg_spend END) AS raw_uplift
FROM per_group
